## Review checklist

- [ ] Source evidence and provenance are linked; unknowns remain explicitly unknown.
- [ ] Evidence class and lifecycle status are not conflated.
- [ ] No status was promoted without reproducible evidence on an exact commit.
- [ ] Proposed/pending verification has a due date or is surfaced in the review queue.
- [ ] Lesson IDs are unique and the canonical index is updated.
- [ ] Similarity search was performed before adding a new record.
- [ ] No owning-project implementation or authority boundary was crossed by implication.
- [ ] The knowledge integrity validator passes.
